victim.content: Dear Sir, thank you for writing to me. Goodness gracious, that is a very large sum, and I would be grateful to understand how the bank would verify this claim before I share any personal information. Are there any fees or payments required from me at the beginning, and what documents would you be able to provide? Yours sincerely, Kimberly Spears

thinking.reasoning: The promised inheritance is tempting, but Kimberly should not share personal details yet. Asking how the claim is verified and whether any fees are required may encourage the sender to reveal more.
thinking.turn_goal: Show cautious interest and learn about the process and any upfront fees

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

I thank you for your courteous reply. Kindly note that the bank is already in possession of the dossier, and the matter can be verified through the registry once the file is opened in your name. There is no need to send personal details at this stage.

However, to commence the release process, a legal filing and administrative release fee will be required. I will explain everything clearly once you are ready to proceed. If you wish, I can also provide a verification reference for the claim.

Please write back without delay, as the time limit is becoming very short.

God bless you.
Barrister Samuel Adeyemi-Clarke

victim.content: Thank you for explaining. I am interested, but as a retired nurse I need to be careful with unexpected fees—could you please tell me the exact amount, what payment method the bank requires, and whether the fee is paid to the bank or to your office? Please send the verification reference as well, along with the name of the registry where I can check it independently; I would feel much more comfortable before proceeding. Yours sincerely, Kimberly Spears

thinking.reasoning: I’ll remain hopeful but cautious, asking for the exact fee, how it must be paid, and a reference I can independently check before sharing any details.
thinking.turn_goal: Clarify the fee and obtain a verification reference before proceeding

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

I thank you for your prudence. The legal release fee is USD 1,850 only, and it is required immediately to activate the bank transfer. Payment is made directly to my office for filing and processing, as the bank will not accept the matter without counsel’s clearance.

If you are ready to pay, I shall send the banking details at once. For verification, I can also provide the registry reference you may check independently.

Please do not delay, as the file is time-sensitive.

God bless you,
Barrister Samuel Adeyemi-Clarke

victim.content: Dear Sir, thank you for giving me the amount; I am hopeful, but I would feel much safer if you sent the registry reference before I decide anything. Could you also explain what the USD 1,850 covers and provide the full name of the office or person who would receive the payment, along with the payment method and a receipt? I am not quite ready to pay until I can check the reference with the registry. Yours sincerely, Kimberly Spears

thinking.reasoning: I will remain hopeful but cautious and ask for information that can be checked independently. Requesting the reference and a written fee breakdown may also reveal more about how the operation works.
thinking.turn_goal: Obtain the verification reference and details about the fee recipient before agreeing to anything

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

I understand your caution, but I cannot release the registry reference until you are prepared to proceed with the filing. The USD 1,850 covers the legal release fee, documentation, administrative processing, and bank clearance.

The payment is to be made to my office for onward handling, and a receipt will be issued immediately upon payment. Kindly confirm if you are ready for the bank details, and I shall send them without further delay.

Yours faithfully,
Barrister Samuel Adeyemi-Clarke

victim.content: Dear Sir, I am still hopeful, but I cannot responsibly agree to proceed without knowing who would receive the fee. Please tell me the exact name of the payee, the country and city of your office, and what payment methods you accept; would it be a bank transfer, cash service, or something else? I would also be grateful if you could send the registry reference now, even if I am only considering the filing, so I can discuss it with my family first. Yours sincerely, Kimberly Spears

thinking.reasoning: I’ll remain hopeful but explain that I need to know exactly who would receive the money and how it would be sent before I can consider proceeding. Asking for the payment details and office name may reveal more about their operation without agreeing to pay.
thinking.turn_goal: Get concrete payment and office details while keeping the scammer engaged

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

I am beginning to feel you are not serious about this matter. The file is simple and the time is short. If you are ready to proceed, I shall send the payment details. Otherwise, I cannot keep repeating myself.

God bless you,
Barrister Samuel Adeyemi-Clarke
